description: This file defines enums and classes for managing, referencing, and playing voice wake chimes, including system and custom sound options, logging behavior, and external sound catalog and player integrations.

methods.name: displayLabel
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for the chime based on its type (none, system, custom).

methods.name: play
methods.description: Plays the specified chime sound, logging the action and reason.
